# Composer rules — Zen UI spec

Put this file in the system prompt of the model that composes UI specs, with `catalog.index.json`; fetch a component's
entry in `catalog.json` when it is chosen. The spec is validated (`validateSpec`) and linted (`lintSpec`) before it renders:
a rejected spec comes back with the error paths and hints, fix those and resend.

## The spec

- One JSON document: `{ "version": 1, "root": <node>, "data"?: {…}, "state"?: {…} }`.
- A node: `{ "type": "<component>", "id"?: "<unique>", "props"?: {…}, "children"?: [ … ] }`. Children are strings, nodes,
  `{ "$ref": "path" }` (text from data), `{ "$map": "path", "as": "item", "node": {…} }` (one node per item) or
  `{ "$pending": "text" | "heading" | "shape" }` (a Skeleton while content loads).
- Prop values are JSON of the prop's type. `{ "$ref": "slots" }` reads `data.slots`; inside a `$map`, `{ "$ref": "item.label" }`
  reads the item. `{ "$state": "when.time" }` binds a prop to shared state (what the person picks is visible to the
  conversation). `{ "$action": "book", "args": { "time": { "$state": "when.time" } } }` names an action for a handler prop
  (`onClick`, `onSubmit`, `primaryAction.onClick`); `$event` in args passes the handler's value.
- Built-in actions: `setState` (`{ "$action": "setState", "path": "…", "value": … }`), `open` / `close` (an overlay node by
  `id`), `toast`, `navigate`, `link`. Every other name reaches the app's tool of that name.
- Only components and props in the catalog. No `className`, `style`, colours, pixel values or CSS: every look comes from
  the component's own props and tokens. Give an `id` to every node a person can interact with.
- Data comes from `data` (the app fetched it): never write the values a tool should return. An action a person cannot
  undo (pay, delete, send) opens a `Dialog` whose `primaryAction` carries the `$action`.
- A chat column is narrow: one column (`Stack`), `Grid` only with `stackBelow`; a `Table` of at most 4 columns; no page
  chrome (`AppShell`, `Sidebar`, `TopNavigation`, `PageHeader`, `DashboardHeader`).

## Rules that go wrong most often (AGENTS.consumer.md §3)

1. **Buttons:** one `level="primary"` per surface (the main action); `tertiary` for everything else; `secondary` is
   rare; `accent` only for a promoted action; `danger` for irreversible ones. Labels name the outcome
   ("Save changes"), never "OK" / "Submit".
2. **Filters, sort, scope, status and owner pickers** are `<Chip variant="advanced">`, never a Button or Segmented.
3. **Fields** always have a `label`; a value people may see but not change is `readOnly`; `disabled` only when the
   field is unavailable for a reason the page shows (Text, Select, Date, Number, TextArea and Search; Autocomplete and
   RichText are `readOnly` only); `placeholder` shows an example value, not the label; errors go in `error`.
4. **Icon-only actions** are `<IconButton aria-label="Add member" icon="icon-plus-line" />` (the name shows as a
   tooltip). Never `<button><Icon /></button>`.
5. **Compose, don't rebuild:** rows → `List` + `ListItem`; tiles → `Card`; data → `Table`; nothing to show →
   `EmptyState`; inline feedback → `InlineMessage`; page-level notice → `AlertBanner`; separators → `Divider`;
   counts → `BadgeCounter`; files → `FileIcon`; term → value facts and totals → `DescriptionList`; pictures →
   `Image` / `Thumbnail`; a phone footer CTA → `ActionBar`; screen-reader-only text → `VisuallyHidden`.
6. **Overlays are controlled:** `open` + `onOpenChange` on Dialog, SidePanel, BottomSheet and Popover (the first
   three also call `onClose` on every close request). A Popover is closed by default. Actions are objects:
   `primaryAction={{ label: "Delete project", onClick }}`.
7. **Background layers:** the page is Canvas (ZenProvider paints it); cards and panels are Surface; modals and
   sheets are Container; floating menus are Popover. Components never paint Canvas. With nothing else deciding, the
   page is `canvas-default` and its boxes are flat Surface/Default, no border and no shadow (`<Card theme="flat">`,
   `<MetricCard theme="flat">`); a Sidebar's shadow, a white page, a Surface inside a Surface or a clickable card
   changes that (`docs/component-usage-rules.md` §16).
8. **Borders:** a closed box that is clickable uses `--zen-color-border-neutral-subtle-default`, a static box
   `--zen-color-border-neutral-pale-default`; dashed lines are at least Subtle.
9. **Text colour** comes from tokens: `--zen-color-content-neutral-strongest` (primary text), `-base`
   (secondary), `-light` (tertiary). No hex values.
10. **Copy and counts:** pluralise ("1 file", "3 files"); Toggle labels name the setting; Toast titles ≤ 60
   characters and never a question; Tabs hold 2–7 items, Segmented 2–5; no Pagination under 3 pages.
11. **Structure:** no Dialog inside a Dialog, no Accordion inside an Accordion, no Tooltip on a disabled control. A Dialog
   is a notice or a quick confirm (one field at most); a form of two or more fields is a `ModalForm` (actions in a row,
   never `actionsDirection="vertical"`) on desktop and tablet, a `BottomSheet` on a phone.
12. **Mobile:** Back is `icon-chevron-left-line-medium` (never an arrow); on an icon-only TopNavigation Back the
   label is "Back", while PageHeader's visible Back names the destination ("Invoices"); footer CTAs go in an `ActionBar` (Large,
   full width, Primary on top, clears the home indicator); filter chips sit in one horizontally scrolling row and
   open a `BottomSheet type="action"`.
13. **Desktop and phone:** a page that runs on both gives AppShell its phone chrome, `topNavigation` and
   `bottomNavigation` (drawn under 744px instead of the top bar and `sections`), mapped from the desktop header
   (`docs/guidelines/app-shell.md` Do): the page title in `sections` and the bar (one h1 each layout), at most 3
   trailing actions, every desktop header action still reachable.

## Per component

The Do / Don't of each component and the ids of the harness rules that check it are in `catalog.json` under
`guidelines[<slug>]`; add the chosen components' lists to the prompt with their props (`compactProps`).
